input: A specific already-built artifact (not a category sentence)
steps: Confirm the artifact is named and showable
Draft a proof post of that one build (do not publish)
Collect inbound “that, for me” — do not hunt
If no artifact yet and Evens allows a room: free work ↔ documented postable proof (HITL)
output: Inbound request for the same class of job, or an explicit gap (no artifact / no HITL)
valid_when: SKU is unknown or the live sentence is a category. A showable build exists or Evens allows free-work-for-proof.
less_relevant_when: Named ICP + named offer + Path A MUST already exists (outbound-first tapes). Do not average.
